WITH linked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    td.tradekind,
    sf.optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader td ON tr.trdref = td.tradereg
),
combo_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    tradekind,
    AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM linked_data
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) as baseline_value
  FROM combo_averages
),
deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.transref,
    ca.tradekind,
    ca.avg_optvolrt,
    ca.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_value as deviation
  FROM combo_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
),
type_avg_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation
  FROM deviations
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_combos AS (
  SELECT 
    d.transref,
    d.tradekind,
    d.avg_optvolrt,
    d.deviation,
    d.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation as excess
  FROM deviations d
  INNER JOIN type_avg_deviations tad ON d.tradekind = tad.tradekind
  WHERE d.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT 
  fc.tradekind,
  AVG(fc.avg_optvolrt) as avg_of_kept_combos_optvolrt,
  AVG(fc.deviation) as avg_of_kept_deviations,
  AVG(fc.excess) as avg_of_kept_excess
FROM filtered_combos fc
GROUP BY fc.tradekind
ORDER BY fc.tradekind
